detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor package fetch requests in proxy repositories for organization-specific namespaces, scopes, prefixes, or critical package names. Implement and regularly test routing rules that block these requests. Review repository logs for blocked fetch attempts of internal or critical package names from public sources, as these may indicate attempted supply chain attacks or misconfigurations. Automated detection systems should alert on any fetch attempt for protected namespaces or package names from untrusted sources, and periodic audits should verify that routing rules remain up-to-date with organizational naming conventions and critical package lists.
